title: Winter warmers
text: Cold mornings call for tiffins that hold heat: dal-rice, keema and stuffed parathas packed hot in a preheated tin.

title: Exam-season tiffins
text: Light, steady food that does not send anyone to sleep in the afternoon.

title: Hot-weather tiffins
text: Cooling, low-risk tiffins for hot days. Pack them cold with two ice packs.

title: Back to school
text: Finger food, rolls and noodles that come home in an empty tin.

title: Festive season, lighter tiffins
text: Between the sweets and the parties, tiffins that keep the week on track.

title: Year-end comfort
text: Holiday weeks, smaller offices and the tiffins people actually miss.
